idea-plugin.name: CCoder (Claude Code Assistant)
idea-plugin.description:
Runs the Claude Code CLI inside a PyCharm tool window: ask against the project you are already editing, see every file edit as a diff before it is applied, and approve or deny the commands that touch your machine.
Requires the Claude Code CLI (claude) and Node.js installed on your machine.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.14

  • Preset prompts: save your own reusable prompts in Settings, then type / in the input box to pick one. The "预设" (Presets) group is listed first.
  • MCP panel: read and edit the project-level .mcp.json. The right-hand column shows the connection status and the error reason of every server in the current session.
  • Hooks panel: read and edit hooks in the project-level .claude/settings.json. Nothing else in that file is touched.
  • Session list: sessions are named after your own first message (the CLI's auto-summary takes a back seat), and the list is now flush with the panel's left edge.
  • While Claude writes a file, the status card now says what it is writing. It used to stay silent for 3.6 seconds, which looked like a hang.
  • Diffs are no longer drawn on the tool card itself. They appear when the card is expanded.

中文

  • 预置 prompt：在设置里存几条自己的常用提示词，输入框打 / 就能选，「预设」分组排在最前。
  • MCP 面板：读写项目级 .mcp.json；右栏显示当前会话里每个 server 的连接状态与错误原因。
  • hooks 面板：读写项目级 .claude/settings.json 的 hooks。同文件里别的内容一个字节不动。
  • 会话列表：名字改用你自己说的第一句（CLI 的自动摘要退居其次），并一律贴面板左边缘。
  • 让 Claude 写文件的那几秒，状态卡提前说明在写什么。此前会静默 3.6 秒，看着像卡住。
  • 工具卡上的 diff 不再直接铺在卡面上，展开才画。
